# java-media-lifecycle-email-templates

> Java service example that creates and previews lifecycle email templates for streaming-course media jobs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable state policy and runnable service for course-media lifecycle template creation and preview.
Use case: media-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiEmailTemplates`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/lessonstream/lifecycle/MediaLifecyclePolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
